subject: Private/VPC demo for Acme Health - scheduling
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-22 09:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Private/VPC demo request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick follow up 204 I signed up through the self-serve form and got a note to schedule a demo. We are evaluating Redwood for a regulated workload (HIPAA-covered patient data) and need to see a Private/VPC or on-prem deployment walkthrough.

A few details up front:
- Primary use case: clinical note summarization + retrieval for internal care teams.
- Data residency: on-prem / VPC with strict network controls and customer-managed KMS.
- Compliance: we will need SOC 2 + HIPAA support details.

Can we schedule a 45-min demo next week? Our team is available Tue/Wed afternoons PST. Would like to include our security lead (security@acmehealth.com).

I attached a short requirements doc (acme_health_system_requirements.pdf).

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Director, Clinical Applications
Acme Health

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-22 09:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Private/VPC demo request

Hi Tom 204 great to hear from you and thanks for the details + the requirements doc. Happy to set this up.

Availability (PST):
- Tue 2026-03-24 2:00-2:45pm
- Tue 2026-03-24 3:30-4:15pm
- Wed 2026-03-25 1:00-1:45pm

I suggest a 45-minute session: 20 mins product walkthrough (Private/VPC + on-prem options), 15 mins SE deep-dive on network/auth, 10 mins Q&A.

I will include Dev Patel (sales engineer) on the invite to cover architecture and security. Laura (CS) is cc'd to help capture next steps and any procurement questions.

If any of those slots work, I can send a calendar invite and a short pre-demo questionnaire so our SEs can prepare.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-rwd/private-vpc-demo

Date: 2026-03-22 11:05 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Acme Health 204 Private/VPC demo request

Forwarding 204 Tom Reynolds (Acme Health) signed up via self-serve and wants a Private/VPC or on-prem demo Wed 3/25 1pm PST. Security lead will join and requested SOC 2 + KMS/network details (attached).

Can you: 
- Confirm SE availability for Wed 3/25 1pm PST (45 min)
- Prepare a short network diagram and KMS/integration notes (how we support customer-managed KMS, IP allowlist steps, VPN/Direct Connect options)
- Bring the demo playbook (rdw_se_demo_playbook.pdf) and note any pre-demo access we need (e.g., sample config, firewall IPs).

I've cc'd Laura for procurement / SOW questions.

Thanks 204 Marissa

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-22 13:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme Health 204 Private/VPC demo request

Marissa 204 I can join Wed 3/25 1pm PST. I reviewed the requirements and security intake. Quick notes for the demo prep:
- We'll demo both Private (VPC peering/Transit) and on-prem installation options (air-gapped deploy).
- For KMS: we support customer-managed KMS via standard HSM/KMS integrations; will show flow for key rotation and envelope encryption.
- Network: will outline IP allowlist, VPN/DirectConnect, and port whitelist. Need to know if their network team prefers inbound-only or mutual TLS.
- Please ask the customer to provide a list of firewall egress IPs (we'll send ours ahead of time) and whether they require proxy-based egress.

I'll attach the SE playbook and a short network checklist to the calendar invite.

Attachment: rdw_se_demo_playbook.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, security@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-03-24 15:47 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Private/VPC demo

Tom 204 confirmed. Calendar invite sent (Google Calendar) for Wed 2026-03-25 1:00pm PST.

Agenda:
1) Intro & goals (5m)
2) Private/VPC & on-prem options overview (15m)
3) SE deep-dive: network, KMS, ops (15m)
4) Next steps / procurement (10m)

Pre-demo checklist for your network/security team:
- Please share firewall/egress IP requirements if possible (we will provide our egress IP list).
- If you want us to demo customer-managed KMS flow, please confirm whether you use AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, or an on-prem HSM.
- We'll share redacted SOC 2 attestation and a short pre-demo questionnaire (link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/acmehealth-pre-demo-questionnaire).

Attachments included: rdw_se_demo_playbook.pdf (SE prep), acme_health_system_requirements.pdf (from you).

Look forward to it 204 Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
